## Today's Question

When exact answers are unavailable, how do we compute responsibly?

## Approximation Is A Claim

Numerical answers depend on:

- method;
- initial guess;
- tolerance;
- step size;
- conditioning.

## MATLAB Pattern

```matlab
f = @(x) x.*exp(-x) - 0.2;
root = fzero(f, 1);
f(root)
```

## Visual Check

Plot before solving. Plot again near the computed answer.

## 3D Plotting

Use surfaces and contours to understand functions of two variables, not just decorate results.
